# MARKER Bindings

> > Official site for MARKER ski bindings, featuring alpine, touring, and racing models including Duke PT, Jester, Griffon, Kingpin, and Comp series since 1952.

MARKER is a German manufacturer founded by Hannes Marker in Bavaria, offering ski bindings across all categories: all-mountain, freeride, touring (pin and hybrid), and FIS-certified racing bindings. The site includes product catalogs, technical guides, mounting instructions, and comprehensive FAQ sections covering DIN settings, GripWalk compatibility, and boot interfaces.

## Key Topics

- MARKER
- Duke PT series (11, 13, 16)
- Jester series (16, 18 Pro, X 16 MWerks)
- Griffon series (13, X 13 MWerks)
- Comp series (10, 12, 16, 20, 30)
- Kingpin
- GripWalk compatibility
- Pin bindings
- Ski touring bindings
- DIN settings
- Triple Pivot technology
- All-mountain bindings
- Freeride bindings
- FIS racing bindings
- Royal Family collection

- [Comp Collection | Marker Bindings](https://markerbindings.com/en-us/comp): Comp racing bindings: Comp 30, 20 & GW models for elite performance
- [All Mountain Bindings | MARKER](https://markerbindings.com/en-us/c/bindings/all-mountain): All-mountain bindings: Comp GW, 10.0 TP & Free series for versatile terrain
